session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, Then Trading Range'. Higher high double top at 6540 led a major bear breakout (beige boxed bars) down a minor parabolic wedge to a sell climax low 6487 (bar 18-24 zone, 08:15-08:40), then a tight afternoon trading range (blue box bars 36-72) with a failed breakout below the tight trading range and a breakout test of a bad buy signal bar (11:05), finally an asecnding wedge thrust above the box at bar 72 into the 6490 close.
